### Settings

- The terminology library, direction library, model groups, layout presets, and other management tools now open as pages within Settings. Return to the parent page to pick up your unfinished edits and resume where you left off.
- General now uses the same layout for Language and startup, Run mode, and App updates. In Development mode, the source folder and Node.js path appear directly under Run mode.
- On Feature switches, the arrows beside feature names are gone. Select a name to open its settings, or use the switch on the right to turn the feature on or off.

### 设置

- 词库、方向库、模型分组、布局预设等管理入口统一在原设置区域打开二级页。返回时保留未保存的编辑和阅读位置。
- 「通用」的「语言与启动」「运行模式」「应用更新」统一对齐。选择开发模式后，源码目录和 Node.js 路径直接显示在「运行模式」下方。
- 「功能开关」去掉名称旁的箭头。点名称进入该功能的设置，右侧开关只负责启停。
